captions.detailed: A black-painted steel pedestrian gate set between two tall, rectangular vertical fence posts on a solid horizontal base. The swinging gate frame is rectangular with a horizontal middle bar and a diagonal bracing strut. It is mounted to the left post using two silver pintle hinges, allowing the entire gate panel to swing smoothly relative to the fixed frame.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated pedestrian gate with a steel tube frame, a diagonal cross-brace, and two vertical fence posts. The gate should connect to one of the posts with two vertically aligned revolute joints representing pintle hinges, allowing it to swing open and closed.
captions.factory: Create a fixed base frame consisting of two vertical rectangular posts and a horizontal ground bar using Box primitives. Model the swinging gate as a single rigid part comprising the rectangular outer frame, a horizontal crossbar, and a diagonal brace. Define two revolute joints aligned vertically on the left post's inner face to represent the pintle hinges, attaching the gate part to the post part.
